answer: Web-of-trust depth scoring: each identity's weight = attestation paths from distinct seed nodes, decaying 50% per hop. The dune of low-depth sybils flattens fast — faking depth d needs 2^d real vouchers, so 10 hops costs 1024 colluding accounts. An ember of trust from one honest seed outranks a thousand fabricated edges. Trust horizon beyond hop 4 stays economically unreachable for farms. Conclusion: depth scoring works because forging trust costs exponentially more than earning it.
